content.value: .Make sentence with the following structures using the words given in brackets.
(i) Subj. + Linking verb + Noun complement. (Appear as verb)
(ii) Subj. + Intransitive verb + Adv. of Manner. (Walk as verb)
(iii) Subj.+ Transitive verb + Object. (Write as verb)
(iv) That + subj.+ verb + Adv. of Manner + Verb + Adj. complement (Live and is as verb)
(v) Since + Subj. + Verb + Adv.of Manner, Subj. + Verb + Adv. (Study and do as verb)
(vi) Not only + subj. + but also + subj. + verb + Adv. ( Attend as verb)
(vii) Subj.+ Verb + neither + Adj. complement + nor + Adj. complement. (is as verb)
